entities.name: A0QSH5
observations: Exact full-length sequence match to the submitted 304-residue protein; reviewed Mycolicibacterium smegmatis protein annotated as a putative S-adenosyl-L-methionine-dependent methyltransferase.
Reference annotation assigns methyltransferase activity, EC 2.1.1.-, and GO molecular function GO:0008168.
Reference binding-site annotations occur at position 127 and positions 156–157.
Predicted sequence properties: molecular weight 32,702 Da, theoretical pI 4.60, GRAVY -0.120, estimated charge at pH 7 of -15.2.
Pfam scan identifies LCM domain PF04072.21 at residues 19–200.
